chunks: And everything in it that is narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, I have transmitted it from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may Allah be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah.

key_terms.عليّ بن أبي حمزة: Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, a prominent narrator of hadith
key_terms.ماجيلويه: Majilawayh, a specific narrator in the chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This statement serves as a crucial methodological note by Shaykh al-Saduq, clarifying that for narrations attributed to Ali ibn Abi Hamzah where the chain was not explicitly detailed in the main text, he relied on a specific, continuous isnad traced through Majillawayh. This ensures the reliability of these reports by linking them to a known, trustworthy source rather than leaving them ambiguous, reflecting the rigorous standards of hadith verification in Shia scholarship.
